defect: none; the one-entry asynchronous mailbox holds write data until a read-side acknowledgement
rationale: The write side accepts data only when idle, holds it in data_wr_q, and uses a persistent request toggle. The read side synchronizes that toggle, samples the held payload, and returns an acknowledgement before the writer becomes ready again.

mutation.description: Reduced prim_fifo_async_simple to a one-entry request/ack mailbox with held data and two-flop control crossings.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the stream ports to one byte and one outstanding item, omitting assertions.
